title: Add explicit ANSI color and emphasis wrappers
problem: Request ANSI styling explicitly around an existing formattable value.
design: Typed composition emits deterministic bytes without terminal detection.
tradeoffs:
Styles explicitly emit ANSI escape bytes around the formatted value and reset
when a nonempty style ends. There is no terminal detection; captured output also
contains those bytes. RGB, terminal palette colors and emphasis flags compose
with `operator|`. Incompatible repeated terminal colors report `invalid_format`.
The wrapped formatter still owns ordinary value parsing and width semantics.

source_provenance.source_changes: Conventional header layout and standalone explicit-style tests/docs. No implementation token change.

before: There is no typed style wrapper to emit ANSI foreground and emphasis around a value.

validation.results: Pending validation of the assembled intermediate commit; root records exact commands and outcomes.
validation.limitations: Portable checks do not establish accelerator runtime availability. No hardware campaign rerun is warranted by whitespace/comments, helper renaming and test decomposition alone.
